title: Operation Shaban Toll Reaches 129 Militants Killed
detail: Three more militants were killed in the latest phase of Operation Shaban, pushing the confirmed toll to 91 killed directly under the operation and 129 in total when combined with other intelligence-based operations conducted across Balochistan since the campaign's July 5 launch. Security forces have sustained the offensive against Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan and Balochistan Liberation Army networks for eleven consecutive days, continuing coordinated ground and aerial operations across the province's mountainous districts.

media.caption: Operation Shaban continues in Balochistan as militant death toll climbs to 129

title: PTI Announces Countrywide Rallies for Aug 5 Imran Khan Arrest Anniversary
detail: PTI's parliamentary party, led by interim chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan, announced countrywide rallies, public meetings, and a long march beginning August 5 — the anniversary of founder Imran Khan's 2023 arrest — to press for his release. The move follows weeks of PTI pressure over Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi's alleged solitary confinement at Adiala jail; the Islamabad High Court has sought a detailed prison report on the claims, with PTI lawyers alleging Khan has lost roughly 85% of vision in his right eye and that Bushra Bibi has retinal detachment, while authorities deny mistreatment. PTI said the August protest movement would be 'of a different nature' than previous efforts and could escalate into a Jail Bharo Tehreek.

media.caption: PTI announces a nationwide protest movement from August 5 demanding Imran Khan's release
